title: SparkByte Assistants
text:
SparkByte Assistants

notes:
Inbound trial from developer conference signup. Founder (CTO = Daniel Kim) building a multi-file code assistant for VS Code and web. Primary ask: long context (50k+ tokens) + predictable per-user rate limits for free tier. Wants SDK examples (TS + Python) that show streaming tokens and resumable uploads for large repo context.

use_case_summary:
Building a VS Code + web code assistant that ingests whole repos. Needs streaming completions, long-context retrieval (50k tokens typical), embeddings for search/rerank. Latency target: interactive (<500ms median for small completions, tail tolerant for large context). Throughput: moderate (100-500 reqs/min average), cost-sensitive (prefers batching/caching recommendations).

blockers:
clarify concurrent request limits
token-window proof for 100k+ context
billing integration questions

next_step:
Send sandbox account + SDK examples; schedule follow-up demo week of 2026-03-22

next_steps_detail:
1) Provide sandbox keys + TS/Python streaming SDK examples demonstrating resumable context ingestion. 2) Share best-practices doc on KV/prefix caching and recommended quantized model variants. 3) Clarify rate limit / quota tiers for SMB free vs paid. 4) Follow-up demo week of 2026-03-22 with engs for integration plan.
